card.title: Xbox Wireless Controller

claims.statement: The Series X|S controller is Model 1914 (USB-C, Share button, BLE), USB ID 045E:0B12 (USB) / 045E:0B13 (Bluetooth); its rechargeable kit is physically the same battery as the Xbox One kit with a USB-C cable.

card.caveats: USB-C diode readings are in an image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
